file_scope_widening_rationale: AC5 requires a regression test, whose established home is test-lit-pipeline.sh Section G (Section F's header comment names this defect as the deferred companion). AC4's edit to sparse-coverage.md invalidates its index-entries.json entry line_count (currently 33), which the extension's convention requires resyncing. Neither addition is discretionary.
scoping_note: Making sparse=true fire on a high repo-mode skip rate changes what the marker says, but both existing consumers poll only mode=global, so nothing downstream currently re-prompts on a sparse repo-mode marker. The plan does not claim otherwise; wiring a repo-mode re-prompt into lit-stage4a-flow.md's SUBINDEX_PRESENT/SPARSE_PROMPT_NEEDED branches is an explicit non-goal, flagged here in case the user wants it as a follow-up.
key_design_decision: Fold the skip-rate signal into the EXISTING sparse boolean via a disjunction (LITERATURE_SKIP_RATE_THRESHOLD, default 50%) rather than adding a parallel flag. This satisfies AC1 and AC3 simultaneously with zero edits to lit-stage4a-flow.md or adhoc-navigation-directive.md. New marker fields (requested/resolved/skipped/skip_rate) are appended strictly after threshold=T, leaving mode=/seg_count=/sparse= byte-for-byte adjacent.
